text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal or an object. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating several objects in the same image. Computer vision has many useful applications in everyday life. For example, it is used in security cameras, medical imaging and shopping apps. It is also very important for self-driving cars, because these vehicles must recognise roads, traffic signs, pedestrians and other cars to travel safely.
